description: Java source code defining the EncryptedMessageWithHeader class, a network protocol message wrapper for Spark, handling headers and bodies with stream support.

classes.name: EncryptedMessageWithHeader
classes.description: A network protocol message class that encapsulates a header and a body, supporting stream reading and progress tracking.

methods.name: EncryptedMessageWithHeader
methods.description: Constructor initializing the message with optional ManagedBuffer, header, body, and body length.

methods.name: readChunk
methods.description: Reads the next chunk of data, handling header and body streams.

methods.name: length
methods.description: Returns total length of the message (header + body).

methods.name: progress
methods.description: Returns the total bytes transferred so far.

methods.name: isEndOfInput
methods.description: Checks if the entire message has been read.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Releases resources associated with the message.
